extracted.name: Royal Icing
extracted.description: This royal icing recipe makes a sweet white icing that dries quickly, making it perfect for decorating gingerbread houses and holiday cookies.
instruction_lines: Beat egg whites in a large glass, metal, or ceramic bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until foamy.
Gradually add sugar and lemon extract; continue to beat on high speed until thickened.
Use to pipe or decorate cookies.
